title: RSVP lifecycle, guest interaction, wishes and privacy

gates.title: Public RSVP personalized vs general clarity, deadlines, plus-one limits & declining semantics
gates.evidence: PublicRsvpForm.jsx + PublicInvitationFeature.jsx enforce rsvpDeadline lock, maxGuests cap, NOT_ATTENDING 0-seat auto-clear, noValidate accessible alerts, and personalized token scope; verified by PublicRsvpForm.test.jsx (8/8 tests) and after/07,08,09 PNGs (0 axe violations)

gates.title: Conflict, expiry, offline & double-tap recovery
gates.evidence: PublicRsvpForm.jsx maps 409, 403/404/410, 429, and offline states cleanly into Khmer/English alerts while blocking concurrent duplicate submissions; verified by PublicRsvpForm.test.jsx

gates.title: Owner RSVP board RBAC gating & formula-safe CSV audit export
gates.evidence: RsvpDashboardPage.jsx + RsvpGuestTable.jsx gate RsvpOwnerActions behind EventContext MANAGE_GUESTS and add exportRsvpsToCsv using safeCsvCell; verified by rsvp.test.jsx (3/3) and guestCsvUtils.test.js (3/3)

gates.title: Wishes privacy compliance, moderation permissions & WCAG 2.2 AA contrast / label-in-name fixes
gates.evidence: WishCard.jsx + WishesPage.css + WishesPage.jsx fixed .wishes-counter-badge color-contrast & Khmer button label-content-name-mismatch (2 before axe violations -> 0 after on 06-wishes-page-mobile-km-390.png), added Lock privacy notice, and gated deletion behind MANAGE_GUESTS; public wishes remain empty by policy
